overview: The community forum reviewed six final design alternatives and the project timeline ahead of the School Building Committee's June 10 meeting to select a single preferred option. Discussion focused on project costs, deed restrictions on city land, and the programmatic trade-offs between renovating the existing facility versus building a new school.

items.title: Project Goals and Selection Process
items.summary: Jenny Graham explained that the committee must select a single design option by June 10 to focus on detailed internal programming and vocational layouts.

items.title: Timeline and MSBA Deliverables
items.summary: Jen Carlson outlined the upcoming deadlines, including a June 26 submission to the MSBA and a projected local budget vote in May 2027.

items.title: Deed Restrictions and Design Evolution
items.summary: Matt Rice reported that 1967 deed restrictions on Edgerly Field led to the removal of option D2.1 and the reconfiguration of other designs to avoid restricted areas.

items.title: Presentation of Six Alternatives
items.summary: Architects presented six current options ranging from a $529 million code-only upgrade to various addition-renovation and new construction models.

items.title: Cost and Programmatic Analysis
items.summary: The team reviewed cost tables for different program mixes, noting that new construction yields a smaller gymnasium due to MSBA reimbursement caps.

items.title: Renovation vs. New Construction Phasing
items.summary: Discussion compared the sustainability of salvaging existing structures against the logistical challenges of a phased, 80-month construction schedule while the building is occupied.

items.title: Site Circulation and Field Inventory
items.summary: Civil engineers presented site plans featuring 360-degree emergency access and the potential for a field-over-garage structure to maximize athletic space.

items.title: Community and Educational Space Justifications
items.summary: District officials explained the needs for specific spaces, including an expanded auditorium, the Welcome Center, and rehoming the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Next Steps and Feedback Deadline
items.summary: The forum concluded with a request for residents to submit design preferences via digital survey by June 7 to inform the final selection.
